additional_info.subject: RE: ID0465020-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002653] Modbus Comm Error CRM:03056000641
additional_info.body:
Buongiorno Valerio,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0465020.
The ticket was opened for an ELMS error appearing on charger
MP/R9 170002653
: "SICHARGE -> ELMS (error): Modbus Comm Error = true, Comm Status Word: 16#7002".
Even though I do not have an explanation for the error message itself, I checked the charger on AWS, and I noticed that the error started on 28.11.2025 at 16:22:
Since then, the Modbus Comm error is appearing all the time, as if the ELMS is trying on and on to set the value.
In my eyes, the trigger of the error is the following:
Warning !! G_ActPwrLimit_SP < G_Min_ActPwr (from EVSE), G_ActPwrLimit_SP = 0 kW, G_Min_ActPwr = 1.5 kW
From the "External Load Management System manual - 8EM5907-0AA00-1AA8.02", I found the following statement:
I believe then that the error is generated by an invalid value communicated by the ELMS to the charger.
Could you please verify this with the customer, and see if the new values are accepted and no ELMS error is appearing anymore?
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0465020-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002653] Modbus Comm Error CRM:03056000641
additional_info.body:
Ciao Valerio,
Thank you for your patience. I got confirmation today from R&D that in the ELMS manual there is a typo. The two registers mentioned
,
G_ActPwr
and
G_ActPwr_Present
, are the same register, so number 17.
To have such register it is therefore required the AC input meter:
Firmware team will adjust the ELMS manual as soon as possible.
Please let me know if any further support is required or we can close the ticket.
With kind regards,
